import sys,asyncio
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,"/opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts")
from telethon_sessions import inspect,make_memory_client
from organic_growth import (_read_voluntary_link,_request_required_invite,VOLUNTARY_LINK_TITLE,MAX_EXISTING_INVITES)
from telethon.tl.functions.messages import GetExportedChatInviteRequest,GetExportedChatInvitesRequest
from telethon.tl.types import InputUserSelf
vault=Path('/root/project-secrets/telegram-robot-leads')
config=inspect(vault)
saved=_read_voluntary_link(vault,config['group'])
print('LOCAL_VOLUNTARY_LINK_PRESENT',saved is not None)
async def verify():
 client=make_memory_client(config['entries'][0],config)
 try:
  await asyncio.wait_for(client.connect(),timeout=25)
  assert await asyncio.wait_for(client.is_user_authorized(),timeout=20)
  group=await asyncio.wait_for(client.get_entity(config['group']),timeout=20)
  if saved is not None:
   result=await asyncio.wait_for(client(GetExportedChatInviteRequest(peer=group,link=saved)),timeout=25)
   try:
    verified=_request_required_invite(getattr(result,'invite',None))==saved
    print('EXISTING_LINK_VALID',verified)
   except Exception as ex:
    print('EXISTING_LINK_VALID',False)
    print('INVALID_LINK_REASON',type(ex).__name__)
  else:
   response=await asyncio.wait_for(client(GetExportedChatInvitesRequest(peer=group,admin_id=InputUserSelf(),revoked=False,limit=MAX_EXISTING_INVITES)),timeout=25)
   invites=getattr(response,'invites',[])
   named=[i for i in invites if getattr(i,'title',None)==VOLUNTARY_LINK_TITLE]
   print('NAMED_LINKS_FOUND',len(named))
   print('INVITE_LIST_COMPLETE',len(invites)<MAX_EXISTING_INVITES)
   if len(named)==1:
    try:
     _request_required_invite(named[0])
     print('NAMED_LINK_VALID',True)
    except Exception as ex:
     print('NAMED_LINK_VALID',False)
     print('INVALID_LINK_REASON',type(ex).__name__)
 finally:
  if client.is_connected():await asyncio.wait_for(client.disconnect(),timeout=12)
asyncio.run(verify())
print('VOLUNTARY_LINK_INSPECTION_READONLY_COMPLETE')
